arxiv:2609.32471.summary: GlowTact introduces a compact optical tactile sensor whose images directly encode contact pressure. A nitrile membrane couples to gel under pressure, changing observed light intensity. Experiments demonstrate light-contact detection, normal-force estimation, and fine contact geometry with simple illumination and camera hardware.
arxiv:2609.32471.authors: Yuxiang Ma, Megha Tippur, Pengfei Ye, Sandra Q. Liu, Haonan Chen, Francis Richard Cottrell, Edward Adelson
arxiv:2609.32471.sensorHardware: Pressure-responsive nitrile membrane and gel interface, single-color illumination, monochrome camera
availabilityNotes: The project page promises code and a hardware guide; release links are not yet listed.

arxiv:2610.10288.summary: TouchScale introduces a 500-hour collection of synchronized human vision and touch captured with one wearable setup. It combines egocentric RGB-D, wrist RGB, and full-hand bimanual pressure measurements. Experiments examine data scaling for tactile prediction, visual recognition, and contact-rich robot manipulation.
arxiv:2610.10288.authors: Dayou Li, Hao Wang, Qianqian Yang, Zihao Zhu, Haoquan Fang, Ziyao Zeng, Yan Han, Zihan Wang, Yan Wang, Baoru Huang, Dilin Wang, Kenji Shimada, Yiyue Luo, Manling Li, Teresa Lv, Mustafa Mukadam, Rakesh Ranjan, Ruohan Zhang, Qi He, Changliu Liu, Xu Chen, Marco Pavone, Bangya Liu, Jiachen Li, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Zhiwen Fan
arxiv:2610.10288.sensorHardware: Tachin Glove; 880 normal-pressure sensing taxels per glove across fingers and palm

arxiv:2610.11945.summary: TACROSS transfers human touch demonstrations to robot learning by aligning contact events across heterogeneous tactile sensors. Its low-cost piezoresistive glove supports human data collection, while sensor-specific mappings create shared tactile representations. Robot demonstrations supervise actions; human demonstrations contribute representation learning and auxiliary supervision.
arxiv:2610.11945.authors: Bo Chen, Huanzhang Hu, Junyang Ma, Bo Yue, Fangdi Yu, Haijier Chen, Xianxin Lai, Shuyu Pan, Zhen Yang, Xiaoquan Sun, Wenze Cui, Zhongliang Jiang, Shaopeng Liu, Jiayu Chen

availabilityNotes: The project page promises hardware designs, software, and a dataset; release links are not yet listed.

arxiv:2610.04363.summary: TacOT uses action and tactile dynamics to match human and robot demonstrations for dexterous manipulation. Dynamic time warping identifies compatible interaction sequences that guide optimal-transport alignment during policy learning. It avoids predefined frame-level pairings and is evaluated on four real-world tasks.
arxiv:2610.04363.authors: Xingting Li, Yifan Han, Zijian Lin, Wei Hou, Chuqiao Lyu, Shoujie Li, Wenbo Ding
arxiv:2610.04363.sensorHardware: Five three-axis Paxini fingertip force sensors on a Manus glove; fingertip tactile sensors integrated into an XHand robot hand
